title: Recover a predecessor builder inspection that exceeded the output budget
failure_signature: A full read of the predecessor evidence builder exceeded the available tool and context output, so the tail was truncated.
candidate_workaround: Index functions first, then read only the function or bounded line range needed for the current implementation.
recurrence_guard: Estimate output size before reading large generated builders and prefer function-level inspection.
rollback: Discard the incomplete read as authoritative evidence and repeat only the bounded relevant inspection.
scope_boundary: Same-owner bounded operational recovery only; no scientific, authority, production, accessibility-complete, security-complete, or independent-reproduction credit.
